speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help you, please tell me how many days old you are and when the rash first appeared. Have you noticed any fever, irritability, or if the rash seems to blanch or change color when you press on it?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection).

The onset of the rash at day 4 in a newborn born to a mother with prior gonorrhea is highly suspicious for this infection, even with treatment 4 years ago. I will request a Gram stain and culture of any lesions or blood work to confirm this immediately.
